rationale: The canonical kana line is already visible for every candidate.
Unlike 高田=たかた and 魚=うお, these medium-risk items do not yet justify more UI chrome without user evidence.
All three lexemes are represented in the blind 50-item human review benchmark, so the decision can be evidence-driven.
Keeping the high-risk hint list at two lexemes prevents reading-hint pills from becoming visual noise.
invariants: public-reading-hints-v82 remains high-risk-only with two lexemes.
No candidate reading, display, layer, or quality changes.
Human review results, when available, must be stored separately before changing this policy.
